maria: after-hours perf alert — nightly-ci bench shows p50 ~2x higher for the small-batch codepath on quantized-ggml models. Started at 02:06 UTC. Anyone able to pick this up? @sachin @oliver
ci-bot: alert routed to #eng-runtime; job: nightly/bench/2260001109; link: https://ci.internal/jobs/2260001109 :rotating_light:
sachin: looking now, grabbing the flamegraphs & kernel logs
oliver: I can repro locally with `./bench --model=quant-ggml --batch=1 --seq=128 --profile=flame.svg`
oliver: attaching quick diff — recent kernel-selector change might have added a fallback for int8 matmul
jena: fyi I rolled the quantization tweak yesterday, will pause further rolls
maria: thanks. @oliver can you paste the top functions from the flamegraph? Also, if you can run with `--kv-cache=off` to check cache interaction
oliver: top hotspots: aten::matmul_int8, runtime::kv_cache_lookup, scheduler::batch_coalesce
oliver: command I ran:
``
./bench --model=quant-ggml --batch=1 --seq=128 --profile=flame.svg --kv-cache=off
```
maria: ok that's useful. @sachin can you spin a tiny dedicated run on the perf cluster with kernels=experimental to see if selector picks the optimized path? If so we can rollback the selector tweak for release
sachin: creating job now: perf/quick/2260001180; ETA ~12m
maria: logging this in the regression board & assigning a quick rollback task. If perf job confirms, we'll revert selector tweak and re-run nightly. :thumbsup:
